description: Read a page's visible text, as rendered in the user's authenticated session. Returns {url, title, text, truncated}; text is the body's rendered innerText capped at 50,000 characters, and truncated is true when the page was longer. Prefer this over session_snapshot when the goal is to read or summarise; prefer session_snapshot when the goal is to interact.

tabId.description: Tab to read; uses the active tab when omitted

name: session_read_page
